heading: `cache` / `cache_delete`
text:
### `cache` / `cache_delete` [RLOW.7.4]

A `cache` action compiles to a terminal action of kind
`ACTION_CALL` ([RDSC.4a.8]) whose expression calls
`FN_CACHE_SET` over the key, the value wrapped in an
`FN_JSON_VALUE` call, and the TTL (zero when the action gives
none). A `cache_delete` calls `FN_CACHE_DELETE` over the key.
The key is the action's string literal ([LGRA.10.3.7]), so it
lowers to a literal. The runtime routes each to its cache
dispatcher entry ([IDSP.7]).

The value goes through `FN_JSON_VALUE` so that any
expression ([LSTO.4.2.1]) — literal or runtime — reaches the
cache as a JSON value.
